title: 第十五章 下山活动第十六章 追魂夺命
content_zh:
服用了那十全大补汤的汤药之后，师兄弟两个人也是在院子之中不断的趟步练拳，打拳的时候虽然并没有与之对应的靶子，但却有种拳拳到肉的感觉。
力气与身上的衣服节节贯穿，究竟有多少的武力看不出来，但是只是这力气就不比一般成年人差。
师兄弟两个虽然也是学习拳法，但更多的却是不断的练习着五禽戏以及其他的导引之法，以拳法修行，更多的是将身体之中的那一股血气宣泄出去。
但若是不断的修行五禽戏等养生导引之法，却能够使得自己身上，潜移默化的受到血气的滋润。
一个是专门惩凶斗狠的手段，一个则是为了自身的性命养护，虽然老二也想多打拳，但是却也是下意识的选择了养生之术。
求真观多少年才有了这些传承。
几十年了才建成的这一个道观，需要在他们两个手中传下去，而不是要有什么好勇斗狠的人。
道家修行要的是养炼身体。
双方走的并不是同一个赛道，只要活的够久，那么终归有一天也能成为宗师级别的人物。
同年龄的人都死了谁还能跟他争夺？
看见两个徒弟在院落之中不断的打拳不断的导引气血，正呼吸吐纳，导引着气血吸收的宋风却是叹了口气:
“师父传下来的养生导引之术终究还是太过普通，如今大多数的药性都散在身体之中，但真正被吸收消化的却是少部分。”
两个徒弟虽然年轻，对于药力的吸收是很不错的，但是却也仍然浪费掉了绝大部分的药力。
老一辈虽然传下来了一些敦实气血的方子，但是哪能比得上周天混元吐息法这样传说中上古神魔留下的玩意儿。
问题是两个徒弟呼吸吐纳还差点。
这周天混元吐息法虽然十分了得，但入门却也并不简单，老大虽然在呼吸法上面有很深的造诣，但最起码还得需要两年时间这才能够满足入门条件。
吐纳这玩意儿差三分就是天与地。
有的时候看起来仅仅只是差一丝，但是这一丝确实不知道要消耗掉多长的时间，才能把它磨出来。
就这还得是老大修行不缀的前提。
老二的话就更悬了。

他的身体确实是异于常人，看起来似乎是有一种后天增长力气的感觉，但终究也是到不了项羽这楚霸王的地步。
不断的养炼身体，打拳吐纳可能比寻常人强一点，但却也强不了太多。
等到两个徒弟消耗掉药力不至于全身通红的时候，宋风则是开口对着老二说道:
“过两天我们要一起下山去表演，到时候你就穿着观里的这一副铠甲，正好演练演练老一辈传下来的枪法。”
“咱们这追魂夺命十三枪也是曾经上过战场，杀过不少匪寇的，你小子力气大说不定还真的能让他再度扬名。”
听到了自家师父如此说，老二宋志的脸上却满是笑容，甚至就连全身的汗水也是并不在乎了。
那铠甲他老早就喜欢穿了。
可惜老爷子上一次只是让他穿了并没多长时间就脱下来了，一直放在屋里不让动，那一身铠甲可真是老帅了。
虽然重量非凡，但是身穿一身铠甲，戴着面甲，手中拿着那马槊，活脱脱一少年将军。
清晨，宋风也是拿着手中的锄头先刨了一下地里的草，松软了一下土地，随即这才继续开始了他的开垦大业。
一直在微风中吐纳呼吸。
content_en:
After taking the Shiquan Dabu Decoction, the two brothers also continued to practice boxing in the yard. Although there was no corresponding target when boxing, they felt like they were hitting the flesh.
The strength is connected to the clothes on his body. It is hard to tell how much force he uses, but his strength is no worse than that of an average adult.
Although the two brothers are also learning boxing, they are more constantly practicing Wuqinxi and other guidance methods. Practicing with boxing is more about venting the blood in the body.
However, if you continue to practice Wuqinxi and other health-preserving and guiding methods, you can subtly nourish your body with blood.
One is a method dedicated to punishing the fierce and ruthless, and the other is to protect one's own life. Although the second child also wanted to box more, he subconsciously chose the method of health preservation.
It took many years for Qiuzhen Guan to have these inheritances.
This Taoist temple that took decades to build needs to be passed down in the hands of two of them, not someone who is brave and ruthless.
Taoist practice requires nourishing the body.
The two sides are not on the same track. As long as they live long enough, they will eventually become a master-level figure one day.
If everyone of the same age is dead, who can compete with him?
Seeing the two apprentices punching in the courtyard, constantly directing Qi and blood, Song Feng, who was breathing in and out, guided the Qi and blood to be absorbed, sighed:
"The health-preserving and guiding techniques passed down by Master are still too common after all. Nowadays, most of the medicinal properties are scattered in the body, but only a small part is actually absorbed and digested."
Although the two apprentices were young and had good absorption of the medicinal power, they still wasted most of the medicinal power.
Although the older generation has passed down some prescriptions for replenishing Qi and blood, they are nothing compared to Zhou Tian's Hunyuan Breathing Technique, which is a legendary thing left behind by ancient gods and demons.
The problem is that the two apprentices are not close to breathing.
Although Zhou Tian Hunyuan Breathing Technique is very good, it is not easy to get started. Although the boss has deep attainments in breathing techniques, it will take at least two years to meet the entry requirements.
This thing is just three points shy of heaven and earth.
Sometimes it looks like there is only a slight difference, but I don’t know how long it will take to polish it out.
This is the premise that the boss is not practicing well.
The second child's words are even more suspenseful.
His body is indeed different from ordinary people. It seems that he has acquired strength, but after all, he will not reach the level of Xiang Yu, the overlord of Chu.
Constantly training his body, punching and breathing may be a little better than ordinary people, but it can't be much better.
When the two apprentices had consumed the potion and stopped turning red, Song Feng opened his mouth and said to the second disciple:
"In two days we will go down the mountain to perform together. Then you will wear the armor in the temple, just in time to practice the marksmanship passed down by the older generation."
"Our soul-chasing Thirteen Spears have also been on the battlefield and killed many bandits. Your boy's strength may really make him famous again."
After hearing what his master said, the second son Song Zhi's face was full of smiles, and he didn't even care about the sweat all over his body.
He had liked wearing that armor for a long time.
It's a pity that the old man only let him wear it last time and took it off not long after, and kept it in the room without letting him move. That armor is really handsome.
Although the weight was extraordinary, he looked like a young general wearing a suit of armor, a visor, and holding the horsetail in his hand.
In the early morning, Song Feng took the hoe in his hand and dug the grass in the field first, softening the land, and then continued his reclamation work.
Keep breathing in the breeze.
